description: Jest's documented custom snapshot matcher (B23e, D128): `toMatchTrimmedSnapshot` calls jest-snapshot 30.5.2's own `toMatchSnapshot` with its `this`, so jest-snapshot calls `this.snapshotState.match` with Jest's arguments and reads `expand`, `snapshotFormat` and `snapshotPath`. A first local run writes every snapshot: the trimmed text under the hint `toMatchTrimmedSnapshot`, one between two `toMatchSnapshot` calls of the same test (its hint is a name of its own, so they are the test's snapshots 1 and 2), one with property matchers, and a thrown error's message through `toThrowErrorMatchingSnapshot`. Every write reaches Jest's totals (`added`). One file, one worker.
